intro_html: Drunken noodles with ground turkey: all the basil, jalapeno, and chewy rice noodles of pad kee mao, with 9 grams of fat per bowl instead of takeout's mystery number. Each serving brings 30 grams of protein for about $4.89 (at everyday cost).
cost_closing_html: About $4.89 a bowl (at everyday cost) for lean drunken noodles. The Thai restaurant charges $14 for pad kee mao, and theirs is not built around 93/7 turkey with macros you can actually track.
shop_smart: Rice noodles are the top line at about $16.79. An Asian market sells wide rice noodles for a fraction of the name-brand box price, and wide noodles are the authentic move for pad kee mao anyway.
Ground turkey at about $12.71 for 3.5 pounds beats ground beef on price and fat both. Watch for the frozen rolls, they run cheaper still.
Oyster sauce, fish sauce, and sriracha are all one-bottle buys that season this batch for about $3 combined and stay in your fridge door for the next ten recipes.
make_it: Weigh your empty mixing pot and write the number down for portioning later.
Soak or boil the rice noodles per the package until just shy of tender, drain, and rinse.
Stir together the soy sauce, oyster sauce, fish sauce, brown sugar, and sriracha for the sauce.
Heat your largest skillet or pot over high heat and brown the ground turkey, breaking it into crumbles, until cooked through to 165F with some crispy edges.
Add the garlic and jalapeno and stir fry 1 minute.
Add the noodles and the sauce and toss until the noodles drink up the sauce and everything is glossy.
Off the heat, fold in the green onions and fresh basil so they wilt without cooking flat.
portion_html: Weigh the full pot, subtract the empty pot weight you wrote down, and divide by 14. Portion to that number and each bowl lands at about 562 calories with 30 grams of protein.

head.keywords: turkey drunken noodles, pad kee mao, ground turkey recipe, lean noodle meal prep, thai turkey noodles, budget thai
steps: Soak or boil rice noodles until just shy of tender, then drain.
Mix soy, oyster sauce, fish sauce, brown sugar, and sriracha into a sauce.
Brown ground turkey to 165F, then add garlic and jalapeno.
Toss in noodles and sauce until glossy.
Fold in green onions and basil off the heat, then portion into 14 containers.
